hook: Only four such maps permute trace-1 elements of a binary field, proving the Hollmann-Xiang conjecture
summary: Hollmann and Xiang conjectured which polynomials of the form t plus a linearized map of 1/t permute the trace-1 elements of a binary field. The author proves only four cases work, using moment identities, and also proves a second conjecture about Kloosterman polynomials. This is a classification proof, so it matters mostly to specialists in coding theory and finite fields.
title: A Moment Proof of the Hollman-Xiang Conjectures on Kloosterman Polynomials
